column1: # What each 6502 routine must leave like the Z80 function (what its callers use): registers A B C D E
# H L IXH IXL IYH IYL BC DE HL IX IY, flags CF ZF; REG:target a register pair (BC DE HL IX IY) that returns a
# pointer (compared relocated to the C64), >REG:target one that brings a pointer (relocated at the entry),
# !BLOCK a block of mapa64.tsv left out of the comparison (targets as in punteros64.tsv).  Memory is always
# compared (the blocks of mapa64.tsv, in C64 form; c64/CODIGO6502.md).
# group objetos_sonido (objetos_sonido.s).  spr_project_entity's HL and C (visible only) are checked through its
# callers; the IX lists of the door cells also hold the blocks whose CPC addresses IX brings as junk from the path
# search (08CC), so that the traps' C64 -> CPC conversion gives them back unchanged
